label: Align Transcript
description: Line up a known transcript with its audio: each word gets its start and end time in seconds (for subtitles, karaoke, or editing by word).

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The ElevenLabs access (wire an ElevenLabsAccess node).

inputs.name: transcript
inputs.description: The text actually spoken in the recording.

outputs.name: loss
outputs.description: How well the transcript matched the audio (lower is better).
